apps.name: WF Schedule
apps.subtitle: Your Whole Foods schedule on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Sign in with your Whole Foods account to keep your schedule, breaks, widgets, and discount barcode on your iPhone.

• Weather on Home for the city you work in
• Theme-colored selected-day bar, plus a shift bar on work days
• Drag the calendar header to expand the month
• Break timer and Live Activity
• Discount barcode for the register

versions.localizedDescription: Home shows weather for the city you work in. The selected-day bar matches your theme, with a second bar on shift days. Drag the white header to expand the month. Placeholder Design meetings and reviews are gone.
Redesigned Home calendar with a day ticker, month grid, and scrolling agenda. Removed the leftover bottom bar that showed through the glass tab bar.
Home Screen icons and settings tiles now match the selected color theme, including a new Rainbow icon.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: WF Schedule creates a dedicated 'Work Schedule' calendar and adds your shifts to it so they stay in sync with your other Apple devices.
privacy.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: WF Schedule rings an alarm when a break or lunch timer you started is over.

news.title: Version 2.8
news.caption: Work-city weather, themed shift bars, and a month you can drag open.
